memories.author: D05
memories.text: Insomnia, obesity, epilepsy. 84‑year‑old woman reports difficulty falling asleep, daytime fatigue, weight 92 kg, waist 108 cm, and occasional brief staring episodes. She is a former smoker (20 pack‑years, quit 2005). On exam: BMI 35, BP 138/84, lungs clear, neurological exam normal except mild post‑ictal confusion. She takes no current medications.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Melatonin 3 mg HS
Trazodone 50 mg HS
Orlistat 120 mg with each main meal
Levetiracetam 500 mg BD
Lamotrigine 50 mg BD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4‑4.5)
Haemoglobin 12.8 g/dL (12‑16)
Fasting lipid profile: Cholesterol 5.6 mmol/L (<5.2), Triglycerides 2.1 (<1.7), HDL 1.0 (>1.2), LDL 3.8 (<3.0)
Fasting glucose 6.8 mmol/L (3.9‑5.8)
HbA1c 6.2% (4.0‑5.6)
ALT 38 U/L (<40), AST 34 U/L (<38), ALP 84 U/L (30‑120), GGT 42 U/L (<50)
Waist circumference 108 cm
Serum sodium 138 mmol/L (135‑145)
Serum creatinine 78 µmol/L (45‑90)

memories.author: D05
memories.text: EEG: Background activity normal for age. No epileptiform discharges or slowing seen. No clinical correlation with reported episodes.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: ‘I’ve been using melatonin and trazodone. Sleep latency improved from 45 to 20 minutes, but I still wake up twice at night. Insomnia Severity Index score 14 (moderate).’

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Stable insomnia, mild weight gain, no seizures. Patient reports improved sleep onset but persistent nocturnal awakenings. Weight 93 kg, waist 110 cm. Former smoker, 20 pack‑years, quit 2005. Exam: BMI 35.5, lungs clear, no focal neurology.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Melatonin 3 mg HS
Trazodone 75 mg HS (increased from 50 mg)
Orlistat 120 mg with each main meal (continued)
Levetiracetam 500 mg BD
Lamotrigine 50 mg BD

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Obesity-related GI intolerance to orlistat; insomnia worsening; seizure-free. Patient reports oily stools and abdominal cramping with orlistat. Weight 94 kg, waist 112 cm. Former smoker, 20 pack‑years, quit 2005. Exam: BMI 35.8, lungs clear, no neurological deficit.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Melatonin 3 mg HS
Trazodone 75 mg HS
Orlistat stopped
Levetiracetam 500 mg BD
Lamotrigine 50 mg BD

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Fasting lipid profile: Cholesterol 5.0 mmol/L (<5.2), Triglycerides 1.8 (<1.7), HDL 1.1 (>1.2), LDL 3.2 (<3.0)

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Breakthrough seizure reported; insomnia persists; weight stable. Patient had a generalized tonic‑clonic seizure lasting 90 seconds with post‑ictal confusion. No injuries. Weight 94 kg, waist 112 cm. Former smoker, 20 pack‑years, quit 2005. Exam: BMI 35.8, lungs clear, neurological exam normal post‑event.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Melatonin 3 mg HS
Trazodone 75 mg HS
Levetiracetam 750 mg BD (increased from 500 mg BD)
Lamotrigine 50 mg BD

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Neurology, Vikram Hospital, for epilepsy review after breakthrough seizure. Request EEG, medication optimization, and safety counselling.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Neurology reply: EEG shows occasional left temporal slowing, no epileptiform discharges. Recommend maintaining levetiracetam 750 mg BD, consider adding clobazam if further seizures. Counsel on seizure precautions and sleep hygiene.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up pulmonology appointment booked for 2026-05-10 at 10:30 am with Dr Suresh Menon (D05). Patient to bring medication list and seizure diary.
